digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage telemetry
propositions: Pass-1 and prerequisite LLM calls produce _usage dicts in runner results but that usage is discarded by callers, leaving no token totals in batch outputs or coverage.metrics for the most expensive passes.
Per-criterion request counts are extracted but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions and observability.

The three pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) must change return type from list[dict] to (list[dict], dict) to thread usage through the chain, with all external consumers in eval_solver, criterion_preview, and fidelity_spot_eval updated atomically.
Usage records are attributed per call with criteria lists; multi-criterion chunks divide token fields equally across criteria while llm_calls and requests count in full for each covered criterion.
Checkpoint-served chunks and raising attempts contribute no usage records; ladder retries append separate call records all carrying the same criteria list.
The sidecar payload must carry coverage.usage with per_call records and per_criterion attribution map, and coverage.metrics must include aggregated token totals.
